description: A vintage wooden dresser with two drawers. The wood has a rich, dark brown finish with visible grain patterns and some signs of wear, suggesting age and use. Each drawer is adorned with an ornate, dark metal handle in a classic, curved design. The dresser has a slightly tiered top and features a decorative, scalloped base with elegant, curved legs. The overall aesthetic evokes a sense of traditional craftsmanship and antique charm. The lighting in the scene highlights the texture of the wood and the subtle imperfections that contribute to its character.
